component.name: org.nuxeo.agentic.letters.listener
component.documentation:
The letters' guards, synchronous, in the transaction of the change that fires them, before the platform's own template listener (priority 500): a letter template is created, changed, copied, trashed, restored or removed by an administrator alone, and saved only when its file and its properties pass the add-on's checks; a letter is created only by Letter.Generate, changed by no one after, and trashed or removed by an administrator alone. Every refusal marks the transaction for rollback.
And the audit's writer: each letter's entry on its record, written to the platform's audit once the transaction that wrote the letter has committed.
